Chapter 586: Chapter 24: Do I Have to Hide? (Please Subscribe)

“`

“Continue to open up more spatial layers…” Lin Yuan’s thoughts converged.

Actually, Lin Yuan could have attempted to break through to the Tenth Rank as early as when he created millions of spatial layers.

According to the experiences of countless Ninth Rank beings in the Main World breaking through to the Tenth Rank, millions of spatial layers were enough to meet the threshold for the breakthrough.

But Lin Yuan did not wish to forsake the greatest opportunity presented by this traversal.

After breaking through to the Tenth Rank, the Inner World would continue to transform and begin to ‘solidify’ to a certain degree.

...

At that time, creating spatial layers as one could at the Ninth Rank would not be so easy.

Instead of that, it was better to open up as many spatial layers as possible while still at the Ninth Rank.

Why did Hunyi, the strongest Ninth Rank being of the Tianyu Clan, open over thirty million spatial layers but still refuse to break through to the Tenth Rank?

Was he foolish?

Certainly not.

Spatial layers represent the depth and thickness of a world, a more hidden foundation aside from its evident size.

The more spatial layers one opens at the Ninth Rank, the greater the help for stepping into the Tenth Rank, and even the Eleventh Rank, when the Inner World transforms into an Inner Universe.

This is also why Lin Yuan is currently opening spatial layers so fervently, although it can’t be said that missing this opportunity would leave him without another chance.

But the opportunity must be seized.

Besides.

Another reason Lin Yuan has not attempted the Tenth Rank breakthrough is the Xuan Huang Secret Realm.

The Xuan Huang Secret Realm prohibits those at the Tenth Rank and above from entering, a rule established since the opening of the Xuan Huang Secret Realm.

Even Supreme Beings cannot forcefully enter, and Lin Yuan worries that if during his traversal, the nature of his Spirit Will transforms, it would be detected by the Xuan Huang Secret Realm as anomalous, and then he would be ‘ejected’ from it.

Of course.

This possibility is not very large.

When Lin Yuan’s will arrives, even if he truly breaks through to the Tenth Rank, it doesn’t have much to do with his main body.

For Lin Yuan, the descent of will also has a ‘trial and error’ purpose.

But to be cautious, considering many aspects, Lin Yuan still prioritizes opening more spatial layers.

After all, with his current accumulation, whenever he wants to break through to the Tenth Rank, he can do it, there’s absolutely no need to hurry the process.

Those Ninth Rank Peak Powerhouses who had just opened millions of spatial layers were anxious to try breaking through to the Tenth Rank because their lifespan was nearing its end.

They had no other choice, that’s why they did it.

Lin Yuan still has plenty of lifespan left, so there’s no need to rush.

“Xuan Huang Secret Realm…” Lin Yuan once again perceived the situation through the Door to the Myriad Realms, sensing the circumstances on the side of the Taiyang Divine Spirit.

“Xilan’s breath has already weakened by nearly a quarter…” Lin Yuan was aware of this numerically, knowing Xilan could still hold on for a while.

As for the damage to his main body’s Avatar caused by burning his Spirit Will? That’s not irreparable; after all, once Lin Yuan finishes his traversal and returns to the Xuan Huang Secret Realm, he can give Xilan some opportunities.

Lin Yuan can foresee that, after his traversal ends, with his strength, he should be able to sweep away all the Ninth Rank beings in the Xuan Huang Secret Realm.

At that time, all the resources in the secret realm would be there for his taking.

Actually, even if Lin Yuan doesn’t experience the entire traversal, he would still be able to sweep through the entire Xuan Huang Secret Realm if he returned now.

…

Ocean of Light.

Hundreds of True Gods were seated in a spacious hall.

Lin Yuan’s two Primordial Spirits abducting a large number of Demigods had completely angered the gods of the Ocean of Light, on top of the massive looting of divine crystals three hundred years ago.

Old grudges and fresh grievances made the gods’ teeth itch for revenge.

“My most devout follower, a Seventh Rank Demigod named Yin Mosi, has vanished without a trace for over two hundred years. I can feel that he is still alive, but I have no idea where he is,” a True God with a single horn scanned the many gods around and said.

“My two Demigod followers are the same. Who could this be, capable of eluding our perception?” another True God, with white wings, spoke.

“My followers are the same.”

“To elude our perception, could they have fallen into another Divine Kingdom?”

“Is it those divine beings from the dark abyss doing this?”

“No, that’s not right. The dark abyss has its own Prime Gods who would not do such a thing,” one said.

Hundreds of True Gods conversed, and eventually concluded that their followers could indeed be in other Divine Kingdoms as this was the only explanation for the gods’ inability to perceive their followers.

However, this Divine Kingdom may not be from living deities, as the remnants of fallen gods’ Divine Kingdoms from the distant past had similar abilities.

“So you’re saying someone abducted our Demigod followers and hid them in a fallen Divine Kingdom?”

“What does the other party want? Why not just kill them? Why do this?”

The gods were puzzled, and while the conclusion seemed incredible, it was the only explanation that made sense of their situation.

“Could it be that a group of powerful Demigods in the mortal realm luckily obtains a divine opportunity and acquires a fallen Divine Kingdom. Then they begin targeting our church’s Demigods, abducting them one by one, and for some purpose, keep them in that fallen Divine Kingdom?”

Soon, some True Gods started theorizing about the cause and sequence of events.

Despite there being many inexplicable aspects, they managed to clarify the reasons behind the events.

“Now what do we do? Where exactly are our Demigod followers and who is the mastermind behind all of this, any clues?”

A True God voiced their doubts.

“Rest assured.”

Just then, a True God sitting in the highest seat spoke up.

He was an Upper-Rank God, one of the most powerful and high-ranking beings beneath the Prime God. He surveyed the hall of gods and slowly said, “I have already given the aura of your followers to the God of Divination over a hundred years ago, for him to deduce the last known location of their presence.”
